parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain names whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). Note the following limits:

- You can specify up to 20 domain names in each request.

- The number of domain names multiplied by the number of feature names cannot exceed 50.

parameters.name: FunctionNames
parameters.description: The feature names that you want to delete. Separate multiple feature names with a comma (,). You can specify up to 50 feature names in each request. For more information, see [Parameters for configuring features for domain names](~~388460~~).
